text: Hi, my grinder from order B-3001 arrived cracked. I would like a refund.

line: Sorry, sorry, could you say that again?

text: Sorry, sorry, could you say that again?

I have looked at your order and I can see the grinder was delivered eight days ago, which is inside our thirty day window for damaged items, so I am going to issue the refund now. Sorry. I have refunded the full 45.00.
